metadata.title: Seedance 2.0 AI Video Generator for Video Workflows
metadata.description: Seedance 2.0 is an AI video generator built around one multi-modal workflow for image to video, text to video, reference-led motion, and video extension.
metadata.keywords: seedance 2.0, seedance 2, seedance2, seedance 2 ai video generator, seedance 2 workflow

home_static.f1_desc: Anchor the output with images, clips, motion, and audio instead of relying on prompt luck.
home_static.f2_desc: Begin with one clear scene idea, then add references and settings only when they help the result.
home_static.f3_desc: Keep track of each video request, review progress, and return to your work without losing context.
home_static.styles_title: A controllable model needs legible capabilities
home_static.styles_subtitle: The homepage should communicate what Seedance 2 does best: reference handling, motion precision, extension, and audio-aware generation.
home_static.use_title: Built for creators who think in references
home_static.use_subtitle: From marketing teams to previs artists, the product should feel closer to a workstation than a gimmick.
home_static.u1_desc: Reuse proven shot language, product framing, and branded motion patterns.
home_static.u2_desc: Prototype camera movement, scene continuity, and visual timing before production.
home_static.u3_desc: Turn trends, music, and visual references into repeatable video workflows.
home_static.faq_subtitle: Start with a clear idea, add the references that matter, then review and refine the video result.
home_static.faq1_a: Start with stills, reference clips, and optional audio so the model has concrete material to follow.
home_static.faq2_a: Use natural language to explain how each asset should influence motion, framing, pacing, and continuity.
home_static.faq3_a: Generate the first result, then adjust references, timing, or prompt direction without rebuilding the whole brief from scratch.
home_static.faq4_a: Uploaded references are used to process your creation request. We explain data handling, retention, and third-party processing in the privacy policy.
home_static.cta_title: Ready to start creating with Seedance 2?
home_static.cta_subtitle: Open an account, explore the creation center, and choose the plan that matches your video workflow.

landing.how_step1: Upload clear reference assets such as images, clips, or audio when relevant.
landing.how_step2: Set the workflow direction, reference emphasis, and output controls.
landing.how_step3: Generate the video result, review continuity, and iterate if needed.

Contact.meta_desc: Reach Seedance 2.0 support for workflow questions, billing, privacy requests, or rollout updates.
Contact.title: Contact Us
Contact.p1: If you have questions about results, billing, privacy, or account issues, we are here to help. We keep this page simple so you always have a clear place to reach support.
Contact.support_desc: For help with orders, failed generations, refunds, or data requests, email us here:
Contact.p2: To help us resolve your issue faster, include your account email and a short description of what happened.
Contact.p3: We usually reply within 24 to 48 hours. If your request is about uploaded images or account data, mention that directly so we can route it correctly.

Pricing.title: Production-grade Seedance 2 plans for paid video work.
Pricing.subtitle: Video generation uses real compute. These plans are built for pitches, previs, campaign tests, and studios that need repeatable commercial output.
Pricing.artist_anchor: A single production-ready previs shot here is positioned against agency storyboards, animatics, and outsourced motion tests, not consumer image generation toys.
Pricing.refill_subtitle: Use a pitch pack for one-off client tests, or move to Studio Monthly when you need predictable render capacity every week.
